statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits consistent with prior transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a known history of cerebral infarction
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient's diagnosis codes are G45.9, I34.0, Z86.73
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
Cardiac event monitoring is ordered to evaluate for potential paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias that may be contributing to these embolic events
Documenting and characterizing any paroxysmal arrhythmia is clinically indicated and medically necessary
